story: Captain Jack could not find his treasure map and asked his crew to help him search for it. The crew searched everywhere on the ship but could not find the missing map. They sailed through a storm and reached a small island to continue their search. A friendly monkey gave back the missing map after Captain Jack asked kindly. They followed the map, found the magic seashell, and felt happy after their adventure.
